copy.headline: Broadway Bank expands to Southlake, adds bankers
copy.caption: Broadway Bank expands to Southlake, adds bankers. Broadway Bank is advancing its North Texas commercial banking presence with three strategic hires, including veteran banking executive Seth Allen as senior vice president and Southlake market president.
